summary.purpose: Frozen Sprint 006 pre-P&L economic baseline contract (D0). No parameter search.
summary.structures: Long ATM straddle; short iron fly (below-nearest |delta|<=0.15)
summary.fills: Diagnostic mid + primary cross; config.fill is sole Surface pricing; cost_model mid is inactive legacy
summary.sizing: Tier A equal_max_loss; short budget 10000; long budget 10000 fallback (may yield long-only)
summary.universe: PIT dvol top 20%; spread_bottom_pct 1.0; max 25 names/side; earnings off
summary.count_eligibility: min_count_pct 0.80 joint Mom+CVG; derived required_count 28 of 35 for (42,8)
summary.expected_dates: Independent A1 entry_date calendar (any surface_valid); reconcile to features_42_8
summary.metrics: Conditional CAR + calendar-aligned 0-fill; no robust_score go/no-go
summary.firewall: No retuning after P&L; correctness changes require a new versioned experiment

count_eligibility.note: Freeze min_count_pct only; 28 is derived for (42,8), not an independent parameter. Apply jointly: mom_42_8_count >= required_count AND cvg_count_42_8 >= required_count. No separate CVG threshold field. D2 implements joint enforcement.

shared_run_config.wing_selection_rule_note: Required BacktestRunConfig string; surface iron-fly implementation uses _choose_below_nearest (abs_delta <= wing_delta_target).
shared_run_config.max_loss_budget_per_trade_note: Legacy required field; does not control Tier A equal_max_loss sizing.
shared_run_config.cost_model_note: Inactive legacy compatibility value on both mid and cross runs. Must not affect Surface P&L or add spread deduction on top of fill. Pipeline does not consume this field.
shared_run_config.max_leg_spread_pct_intent: Apply to every traded leg (long-straddle call/put and all four iron-fly legs). Current code filters straddle bodies and iron-fly OTM wings only; iron-fly ATM body shorts are unfiltered until D2.
shared_run_config.tier_a_fallback_rule: Normally longs are financed by collected short premium. If there are no usable shorts or collected short premium is non-positive, use tier_a_long_budget=10000. This may produce a long-only book on that date.

fill.label: mid
fill.meaning: All legs filled at mid. Sole Surface execution pricing for this run.

fill.label: cross
fill.meaning: Buys at ask, sells at bid. Sole Surface execution pricing for this run; primary economic view.

execution_pricing.d1_verification_required: Confirm mid/cross prices apply correctly and no additional spread deduction occurs beyond fill.

structure_and_settlement.long: ATM straddle from A1 body_strike / A2 is_body
structure_and_settlement.short: Iron fly; wings via _choose_below_nearest at abs_delta <= 0.15
structure_and_settlement.holding: Weekly surface entry; hold to expiry
structure_and_settlement.settlement: Intrinsic payoff at A1 exit_spot on expiry; no exit spread
structure_and_settlement.missing_structure: Keep candidate with structure_ok=false and failure_reason; not included_in_portfolio

ranking_and_selection.momentum_rank: rank(pct=True, method=average) within PIT and count-eligible cross-section
ranking_and_selection.cvg_within_side: keep highest cvg_filter_pct by cvg rank within each side
ranking_and_selection.cap_tie_break: After side rank sort, secondary key ticker ascending (D1/D2 must pin if current sort is unstable)

expected_dates.authority: Sorted unique A1 entry_date values in [run_start_date, run_end_date], including dates that appear only on surface_valid=false rows
expected_dates.reconcile_to: features_42_8.parquet dates in the same closed interval
expected_dates.feature_dates_absent_from_a1: Report in reconciliation evidence; not members of the expected calendar

date_status_taxonomy.valid_no_trade: Pipeline completed; zero included names for an allowed economic reason
date_status_taxonomy.failed: Incomplete processing, missing features vs A1, schema/identity failure, or unresolved exception

conditional_deployed_capital_view.valid_no_trade: NaN (zero denominator); excluded from conditional Sharpe and drawdown
conditional_deployed_capital_view.label: conditional on traded dates

calendar_aligned_view.failed: blocks presentation as a complete result

metrics_contract.weekly_win_rate: Fraction of finite traded book-return weeks with return > 0; report no-trade frequency separately
metrics_contract.profit_factor: sum(positive weekly book pnl) / abs(sum(negative weekly book pnl)); +inf if denom=0 and numer>0; NaN if both 0

samples.S1: Median A1 expected date; if traded, lowest-ticker included long and short that exist
samples.S2: Earliest traded date with both sides; else earliest long-traded and/or short-traded as available
samples.S4: Earliest date with structure_ok=false; else N/A
samples.shortfall: If fewer than six qualifying trade rows, audit those available and document shortfall

reproducibility_and_evidence.command_requirement: One documented command using explicit snapshot/derived paths only; mutable cache forbidden

pnl_firewall.correctness_change_after_exposure: Create a new versioned experiment ID; do not silently overwrite

handoff.d1: Trusted runner/CLI; fill pricing verification; tie-break pin
handoff.d2: Joint min_count_pct enforcement; A1 expected-date status; all-leg max_leg_spread_pct
handoff.d3: Decision report dual views and required metrics
handoff.d4: Smoke, manual sample, full mid+cross execution, closeout
